## Overview
### Introduction to Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B
Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a standard, non-open-source model provided by Qwen, released on January 1, 2024. This model boasts a robust architecture, with capabilities including text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs. Its primary strengths lie in its ability to handle a wide range of tasks, from chat and text generation to coding, analysis, and summarization, making it a versatile tool for developers.

### Technical Specifications and Use-Cases
Technically, Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B has a context window of 262,144 tokens and can generate up to 65,536 tokens as output. Its knowledge cutoff is December 2023, ensuring it has a broad and up-to-date understanding of the world. The model's pricing is structured around input and output tokens, with costs of $0.26 per 1M input tokens and $2.08 per 1M output tokens. Its benchmarks show a strong performance in MMLU with a score of 87.0 and an LMSYS Arena ELO of 1270. This model is best utilized for applications such as chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization, leveraging its capabilities in function calling and structured outputs.
